title: Scars - The Lady In The Car With Glasses {1981}

lines.l: Driving on the continent with a pistol in her lap
Followed by a handsome man who says his name is Jack
Pitching round his holidays cause he doesn't have the cash
To hire a borrow motor car, so he's happy with his feet
She brings him out from Paris, France, he says he's going to Spain
He puts a hand upon her thigh and asks to watch your name
She puts a gun against this headland, blood flows everywhere
She dumps him down a lonely guard and then goes on high
Driving round the continent with a pistol in her hand
Gone out of the right-hand window, shoot an innocent man
Remove your glasses, watch and smile, you never shot him dead
Revere three times in where he lies and finish off the job
On to Switzerland, sun and snow
Where the people's sea and cold winds blow
Shoot a few men from your own room
As they see the real oblivious
She is, she is, yes she is
The lady in the car
With the glasses on and the gun
We'll be right back.
